name: cairn.volume
title: Volume (ray marching)
description: Renders cairn.Volume grids with WebGL2 ray marching: colormap transfer function, density, step count and a slice plane.

settings.label: Density
settings.help: Opacity per unit length; higher is more opaque.

settings.label: Steps
settings.help: Samples along each ray: quality vs. speed.

settings.label: Threshold
settings.help: Normalized values below it are transparent.

settings.label: Slice plane
settings.help: Cut the volume and show the cross-section.
